name: io.github.whatzmcp/whatzmcp
title: whatzmcp
description: Self-hosted WhatsApp MCP server: read, search and send messages from your own WhatsApp account.

environmentVariables.name: WHATZMCP_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Data directory for the WhatsApp session, the message database and config.json. Defaults to ~/.whatzmcp.

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Volume that keeps the WhatsApp session and messages between runs.
